summary: Implemented `merge` (clubroll/merge.py, wired into cli.py) per docs/merge.md; it runs on the real data and all other tests pass. tests/test_merge.py::test_import_record_survives expects a `marketing` of `no` to survive an older record's `yes`, which contradicts merge.md section 6 (latest non-empty answer wins); I followed the doc, so that one test fails.
